property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list, calling transfer must forward exactly one transferFrom(from, to, v) call to caddress per recipient using the correct 4-byte selector and return true, which the buggy version violates because it encodes the wrong selector and the recipient never records any transferFrom call.
change_summary: Change the selector hash string from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transferFrom(address,address,uint2560), causing a different function selector to be called.
